entities.name: Xandria
entities.description: A former scholar of Meletis transformed into an immortal siren by a jealous god, trapped on an island and shunned by the other sirens until she kills a man.

entities.name: Ninis
entities.description: Xandria's beautiful and brilliant lover, a young scholar of Meletis, marked by a god as a baby and left unwaking on the beach.

entities.name: The jealous god
aliases: one of the pantheon that ruled Theros
entities.description: An unnamed god of Nyx who marked Ninis as its own and transformed Xandria into a siren as the consequence of loving him.

entities.name: Tolios
entities.description: A shipwrecked sailor of Meletis whom Xandria finds on her beach; he tries to stab her and she kills him.

entities.name: Chakros
entities.description: A young mage on the Meletian trireme on his first command, whose insistence on a southern course led the ship into siren waters.

entities.name: The sirens
entities.description: Winged, black-feathered predators of the islands whose song entrances men and who feast on shipwrecked sailors; they shun Xandria.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A city of Theros with an academy, home of Xandria, Ninis and Tolios.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane ruled by a pantheon of gods from Nyx.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The night sky, land from which the gods of Theros rule.

entities.name: The Siren Sea
entities.description: The sea whose edge holds the rocky islands where the sirens live.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A city whose sailors may work on Meletian vessels.

events.summary: Xandria lures a vole with her song and eats it, as she must eat to satisfy a compulsive hunger.
events.quote: She opened her mouth wide as the vole crawled on to her face.

events.summary: The sirens spot a Meletian trireme far off course in the storm and Xandria flies toward it.
events.quote: The ship was a trireme out of Meletis, large and majestic

events.summary: The sirens attack the ship; crew members walk willingly overboard, entranced by the song.
events.quote: many of them walked willingly over the railing of the ship

events.summary: Xandria considers helping the mage on deck but refuses, remembering that the sirens punished her interference before.
events.quote: She would not help this man.

events.summary: A siren gouges the mage's back and he walks serenely to her song to be eaten.
events.quote: But his face, so recently dominated by rage and fear, now looked serene.

events.summary: Flashback: Xandria and Ninis meet at the academy in Meletis, talk for days and spend a night together on the beach.
events.quote: until one night they walked onto the beaches outside the school, and they stayed together throughout the night

events.summary: Flashback: a god appears from the water, leaving Ninis unwakeable.
Flashback: the god reveals it marked Ninis as its own at birth and curses Xandria with the consequences of attraction.
events.quote: I marked him as mine when he was a baby in his mother's arms.

events.summary: Flashback: the god touches Xandria, transforming her into a siren and condemning her never to leave or die.
events.quote: You will learn the consequences of attraction.

events.summary: Flashback: Xandria finds she is bound to her island by an invisible leash.
events.quote: she found she was trapped, an invisible leash linked her to her island

events.summary: Flashback: the sirens show Xandria two shipwrecked sailors and kill them with their song while she watches in horror.
events.quote: the siren walked up to the man and snapped off most of his neck with one bite

events.summary: Flashback: Xandria attacks a siren; the sirens pin her down and peck out pieces of her cheek, which heals, and they shun her.
events.quote: They laughed at her, and each one pecked at her cheek, tearing out a small bit of flesh and muscle

events.summary: Flashback: the sirens drive away her food in retaliation for her interference, breaking her.
events.quote: Until the time when they changed their tactics and instead drove all her food away. That had broken her.

events.summary: Xandria finds a survivor on her beach, Tolios, and nurses him tenderly.
events.quote: She turned him over, gingerly, with softness and care.

events.summary: Xandria and Tolios speak; he reveals the mage Chakros took the ship through the siren straits.
events.quote: Chakros demanded we cut south through the storm instead

events.summary: Tolios lures Xandria close and tries to stab her with a hidden dagger; she sings and pacifies him.
events.quote: the dagger in that previously still hand coming out of nowhere aimed straight at her face

events.summary: The other sirens gather around Xandria and for the first time smile and stroke her, accepting her.
events.quote: They reached out their hands and stroked her feathers and her back, cooing and trilling, but not singing.

events.summary: Xandria bites into Tolios's neck and devours him, joining the sirens' song.
events.quote: She opened her mouth wide and bit into his neck with a ferocious bite.

relations.quote: He was beautiful. He was smart. And he was hers.

relations.note: The god transformed Xandria into a siren as punishment
relations.quote: The first morning after the jealous god had wreaked its vengeance

relations.note: Xandria bites his neck and eats him
relations.quote: She opened her mouth wide and bit into his neck with a ferocious bite.

relations.note: The sirens shunned and tormented her until she killed Tolios
relations.quote: from that moment, the sirens refused to speak with her, refused to even look at her

relations.note: The sirens accept her at the end, calling her their sister
relations.quote: the songs of the sirens, the songs of her sisters, filled the heavens

relations.note: The mage hurled fire at the sirens
relations.quote: he hurled fire at the others to keep them at bay

relations.note: Xandria is bound to her island on the edge of the Siren Sea
relations.quote: The ship was far off course to be on this edge of the Siren Sea.
